title: Business Central Trivia Recap: September 28–October 2, 2026
summary: A recap of the Business Central Trivia event from September 28 to October 2, 2026, highlighting that 61% of answers were correct, performance by category, and new features added to the trivia website including dark mode, notifications, improved stats tracking, and faster gameplay.
key_points: The event had 250 questions across five days with a 61% overall correct answer rate
Sustainability was the toughest category at 37% correct, while BC Acronyms was easiest at 78%
New features include dark/light mode toggle, notifications, a Today card showing progress and streaks, and faster play with keyboard shortcuts
Enhanced stats pages now show category-specific accuracy and event comparisons with easier tab-based navigation
The game can be installed on phone home screens for quick access, with the next round starting October 5

quotes.text: AI & Copilot improved from being one of the hardest categories last week to 71% correct answers this week.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows user familiarity with AI and Copilot capabilities is increasing as a knowledge area

quotes.text: You can answer using the 1 to 4 keys, and press Enter to move to the next question.
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates improved user experience through keyboard shortcuts for faster engagement
